selection_reasoning: I selected 'find magenta_terracotta' as the single atomic task. This is a straightforward visual search task where the agent must locate a magenta terracotta block placed in the scene. It is observable and verifiable — the agent needs to navigate the environment and orient its view so that magenta terracotta appears in its field of vision. This task does not require deep Minecraft domain knowledge (no crafting recipes, redstone mechanics, or combat), but it does require spatial awareness and visual recognition of a distinctly colored block. As a single task, no dependency edges are needed, but the scene can be designed to make the search non-trivial by placing the block at a moderate distance or partially obscured.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate close enough to the magenta terracotta and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the target.' The target is the center of the 2x2 magenta terracotta structure at spawn-relative [8, 0, 8]. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range (the blocks are ~11 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the blocks rather than facing away.

scene_description: An open grassy area with a stone brick platform at spawn. Magenta terracotta blocks (2 wide x 2 tall) are placed ~11 blocks away at coordinates ~8,~0,~8 (southeast diagonal). Several distractor terracotta blocks (orange, lime, yellow) are placed in other directions. Oak, spruce, and birch log pillars provide landmarks. The clearing of air ensures the target is visible once the player turns in the right direction.
task_text: Find the magenta terracotta blocks in the scene. Look around and navigate toward the distinctive pink/magenta colored blocks.
design_notes: The magenta terracotta is placed at ~8,~0,~8 (diagonal from spawn, ~11 blocks away). The 2x2 structure (2 wide × 2 tall) makes it visible from a distance. Distractor terracotta in other colors (orange, lime, yellow) are placed in different directions to test color recognition. The air fill clears natural trees within the 12-block radius to ensure visibility. The stone brick platform marks spawn clearly. Player must turn ~135° southeast to find the target.
